title: Social card source
description: A JSON card, or the YAML front matter plus panels of a Markdown card. A code card (the default) has panels; a diagram card ("kind": "diagram", JSON only) has a diagram. Character and count limits are enforced here; per-panel line limits are listed as x-maxLines per layout. A card that passes this schema can still fail to fit (code at the minimum font size, a diagram taller than its space), which only a real render detects. Rules that span fields (anchors naming real nodes, edge types naming legend ids, nodes not sharing a cell, 8-character labels on left/right edges) are checked by the renderer, not here.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the renderer.

kind.description: What the card body is: "code" panels, or a "diagram" of nodes and edges (JSON only).

title.description: First title line. At most 70 characters.

highlight.description: Second title line, in the accent colour. At most 70 characters.

subtitle.description: One or two sentences under the title. At most 150 characters.

insight.description: The "design note" under the panels. At most 220 characters.

issue.description: Issue number shown in a running head at the top. Omit it and the card shows no issue number. At most 12 characters.

layout.description: Panel arrangement. "stack": 1 to 2 panels; at most 18 lines per panel with 1 panel, 9 lines per panel with 2 panels; code font 28 to 18 px. "columns": 2 panels; at most 16 code lines per panel; code font 22 to 15 px. "grid": 3 to 4 panels; at most 10 code lines per panel; code font 20 to 14 px.

panels.description: Code panels, in order. How many depends on the layout. Code cards only.

then.description: "stack": 1 to 2 panels; at most 18 lines per panel with 1 panel, 9 lines per panel with 2 panels; code font 28 to 18 px.
"columns": 2 panels; at most 16 code lines per panel; code font 22 to 15 px.
"grid": 3 to 4 panels; at most 10 code lines per panel; code font 20 to 14 px.

anchor.description: A point on a node: "node.side" or "node.side@0.3", where side is top, bottom, left, right and the fraction (default 0.5) runs left to right or top to bottom.

diagram.description: Diagram cards only. Nodes on a 3-column grid, edges between anchors, and a legend each edge type refers to.

id.description: Letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter.

tone.description: Colour role; the theme decides the colour.

id.description: Letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter.

eyebrow.description: Small caps line above the title. At most 22 characters.

badge.description: Short tag before the title, e.g. ".NET". At most 8 characters.

items.description: A line under the title. At most 60 characters.

mono.description: Lines in the monospace face, for paths and names.

tone.description: accent, danger, info or success tint the border; muted is a dashed note.

id.description: Letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter.

label.description: Caption on the frame. At most 60 characters.
Edge label. An edge between two left/right anchors sits in a column gutter and allows 8 characters. At most 20 characters.

sublabel.description: Smaller second line; needs a label. At most 24 characters.

busOffset.description: Bus edges only: px from the many-ended side to the bus line.

label.description: Panel header text. Defaults to the language name. At most 45 characters.

language.description: A Shiki language id or alias, e.g. "csharp", "cs", "ts", "yaml", "jsonc".

code.description: The code. Line limit per panel depends on the layout (see x-maxLines). At most 4000 characters.

highlightLines.description: One-based line numbers to highlight; each must be within the code.

underline.description: Up to 6 exact single-line substrings of the code to underline.

verdict.description: Tick or cross badge and header tint.

notes.description: Up to 3 short bullet points under the code.
